samples.gvd:
module signal_generator(
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    output reg [4:0] wave
);

    reg state;
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            state <= 1'b0;
            wave <= 5'b00000;
        end
        else begin
            case (state)
                1'b0: begin
                    if (wave != 5'b11111) begin
                        wave <= wave + 1'b1;
                    end
                    else begin
                        state <= 1'b1;
                    end
                end
                1'b1: begin
                    if (wave != 5'b00000) begin
                        wave <= wave - 1'b1;
                    end
                    else begin
                        state <= 1'b0;
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="signal_generator">
    <description>Implement a Triangle Wave signal generator module that generates a waveform by incrementing and decrementing a 5-bit signal named "wave". The waveform cycles between 0 and 31, which is incremented or decremented by 1.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <output id="wave" width_description="[4:0]">5-bit output waveform signal representing the generated waveform.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="state">FSM state variable used for controlling the waveform generation.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="next_state" width_description="[0:0]">Next state variable for controlling the waveform generation.</signal>
        <signal id="next_wave" width_description="[4:0]">Next waveform variable for representing the generated waveform.</signal>
        <assign>
            <lhs id="next_state">next state</lhs>
            <rhs>state</rhs>
        </assign>
        <assign>
            <lhs id="next_wave">next wave</lhs>
            <rhs>5'b00000</rhs>
        </assign>
        <always>
            <trigger>
                <posedge>clk</posedge>
                <negedge>rst_n</negedge>
            </trigger>
            <if>
                <condition>~rst_n</condition>
                <then>
                    <assign>
                        <lhs id="state">state</lhs>
                        <rhs>next_state</rhs>
                    </assign>
                    <assign>
                        <lhs id="wave">wave</lhs>
                        <rhs>next_wave</rhs>
                    </assign>
                </then>
                <else>
                    <case>
                        <switch>
                            <case_value>state == 0</case_value>
                            <case_action>
                                <if>
                                    <condition>wave != 31</condition>
                                    <then>
                                        <assign>
                                            <lhs id="next_wave">next wave</lhs>
                                            <rhs>wave + 1</rhs>
                                        </assign>
                                    </then>
                                    <else>
                                        <assign>
                                            <lhs id="next_state">next state</lhs>
                                            <rhs>1</rhs>
                                        </assign>
                                    </else>
                                </if>
                            </case_action>
                        </switch>
                        <switch>
                            <case_value>state == 1</case_value>
                            <case_action>
                                <if>
                                    <condition>wave != 0</condition>
                                    <then>
                                        <assign>
                                            <lhs id="next_wave">next wave</lhs>
                                            <rhs>wave - 1</rhs>
                                        </assign>
                                    </then>
                                    <else>
                                        <assign>
                                            <lhs id="next_state">next state</lhs>
                                            <rhs>0</rhs>
                                        </assign>
                                    </else>
                                </if>
                            </case_action>
                        </switch>
                    </case>
                </else>
            </if>
        </always>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Implement a Triangle Wave signal generator module that generates a waveform by incrementing and decrementing a 5-bit signal named "wave". The waveform cycles between 0 and 31, which is incremented or decremented by 1.</implementation>
</module>
